capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: EV Database Panasonic 2170L pack: 82.0 kWh nominal; evspecifications 2021 North American LR AWD: 82.1 kWh. Carried over from the 2021 Fremont-built LR AWD/Performance; EU 2022-23 Performance cars use the LG 78.1 kWh pack, which does not apply to Fremont cars. Not verified for North America.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: EV Database Panasonic 2170L pack: 76.0 kWh usable. Carried over from the 2021 Fremont-built LR AWD/Performance; EU 2022-23 Performance cars use the LG 78.1 kWh pack, which does not apply to Fremont cars. Not verified for North America.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: NCA (Panasonic); evspecifications 2021 LR AWD NCA; Wikipedia: Fremont cells are Panasonic NCA. Carried over from the 2021 Fremont-built LR AWD/Performance; EU 2022-23 Performance cars use the LG 78.1 kWh pack, which does not apply to Fremont cars. Not verified for North America.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: 357 V nominal, 400 V architecture. Carried over from the 2021 Fremont-built LR AWD/Performance; EU 2022-23 Performance cars use the LG 78.1 kWh pack, which does not apply to Fremont cars. Not verified for North America.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Tesla's release note (2020.24.6.4, Model S/3/X/Y) says the car preconditions its battery when navigating to a fast charger; this is a software feature delivered to the whole Model 3 line (2022 Performance). Page mentions no manual battery-warming control. A manual control was neither found nor ruled out: Tesla's owner's manual pages were blocked (403) and scheduled-departure preconditioning in search excerpts is cabin-oriented.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: 250 kW (EV Database; evspecifications 2021 LR AWD 250 kW). Carried over from the 2021 Fremont-built LR AWD/Performance; EU 2022-23 Performance cars use the LG 78.1 kWh pack, which does not apply to Fremont cars. Not verified for North America.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Performance shares the LR pack and the manual names only the Long Range battery. Tesla service manual: up to 48 A with the Long Range battery (about 11 kW; 48 A x 240 V = 11.5 kW); Basenor groups 2020-2023 LR and Performance at 48 A. 2022 Performance
